heading: Powers
lead: The corporation has only the powers provided in its bylaws and articles of incorporation filed in each State in which it is incorporated.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 7030636:2202.Jan. 8, 1983, Pub. L. 97–427, § 2, 96 Stat. 2265. The words “and subject to the laws of such State of States” are omitted as unnecessary.
